# qbittorrent Provider

Manage selected preferences and categories on qBittorrent 5.3.0 (Web API 2.16.2). Credentials must already exist on the server. TLS certificates are verified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    qbittorrent = {
      source  = "m11s-io/qbittorrent"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Set QBITTORRENT_API_KEY, or QBITTORRENT_USERNAME and QBITTORRENT_PASSWORD.
provider "qbittorrent" {
  url = "https://qbittorrent.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Existing Bearer API key. Defaults to QBITTORRENT_API_KEY. Mutually exclusive with username/password.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Session password. Defaults to QBITTORRENT_PASSWORD. Cookies remain in memory and never enter state.
- `url` (String) Absolute HTTP(S) WebUI URL, including any proxy base path. Required here or through QBITTORRENT_URL. No embedded credentials, query or fragment.
- `username` (String) Session username. Defaults to QBITTORRENT_USERNAME.
